scope: Per-chip mandatory job ownership lower envelope, not fullFFN attainable latency. Command250ns, complete private ONFI input, finitePB ECC duration, last-page ONFI tail. Ignores GU release skew, global command/channel/PCIe contention and scheduling idle.
shared_exact_search: On learned g4 four-chip groups, enumerate2925 compositions of24shared pages per chip-group. Each group uses the same integer page count on its four chips; sum96pages/1536rows. support_search: Prospective standard local-search control, not new algorithm. For each layer, warm-start shared-composition winner;4096seeded proposals moving one routed12page shard to an empty chip (equal-row free4support). Then4096seeded routed page-transfer proposals with delta in1,4,all-source pages plus occasional shared-page transfers. Accept strictly smaller TRAIN mean critical work. capacity: Single-copy coefficients. Per-chip GU plane0/1 occupancy128WL; Down per-plane0 reservation sum ceil(job_pages/4). Require128+Down<=192. This is a conservative same-one-block certificate and hence no larger allocated capacity than the selected winner.
relaxation: A separate route-dependent collision-free minmax job packing gives an optimistic lower bound; it cannot be implemented by changing a fixed one-copy mapping per query.
